# LifeOS Agent API operations

Legacy catalog API version `1`; the v2 catalog uses API version `2` and requiredScopes arrays. Business paths retain their listed versions.

| ID | Method | Path | Required scopes | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `snapshotJournal` | `GET` | `/v1/records/journal/snapshot` | `journal:read` | Read the complete current journal snapshot with source identities, fields and revisions, or fail without a partial inventory. |
| `getJournal` | `GET` | `/v1/records/journal/{id}` | `journal:read` | Read one owner journal record with complete fields and its current revision. |
| `createJournal` | `POST` | `/v1/records/journal` | `journal:read, journal:write` | Create one journal record through the native owner writer with complete fields and an idempotency key. |
| `updateJournal` | `PATCH` | `/v1/records/journal/{id}` | `journal:read, journal:write` | Update one journal record with complete fields, expectedRevision and an idempotency key; reread the same ID after saving. |

| `updateCalendar` | `PATCH` | `/v1/records/calendar/{id}` | `calendar:read, calendar:write` | Update one calendar record with complete fields, expectedRevision and an idempotency key; reread the same ID after saving. |

| `snapshotFeedback` | `GET` | `/v1/feedback/snapshot` | `feedback:read` | Read the complete owner feedback snapshot with explicit source channels and revisions. |
| `getFeedback` | `GET` | `/v1/feedback/{id}` | `feedback:read` | Read one owner feedback record to verify the result and its revision. |
| `createFeedback` | `POST` | `/v1/feedback` | `feedback:read, feedback:write` | Create feedback with the server-owned agent-feedback channel and an idempotency key; this does not approve or convert a requirement. |
| `snapshotStorageReviews` | `GET` | `/v1/storage-reviews/snapshot` | `storage-review:read` | Read the complete owner storage-review singleton (zero or one) with checklist, decisions, source identity and revision. No filesystem access. |
| `getStorageReview` | `GET` | `/v1/storage-reviews/{id}` | `storage-review:read` | Read the exact storage-review record ID returned by the snapshot or receipt, including all saved owner decisions. |
| `createStorageReview` | `POST` | `/v1/storage-reviews` | `storage-review:read, storage-review:write` | Upload an explicitly supplied private checklist once through the reviewed writer using fields.checklist and an idempotency key. No scan or file action. |
| `updateStorageReviewChecklist` | `PATCH` | `/v1/storage-reviews/{id}/checklist` | `storage-review:read, storage-review:write` | Update fields.checklist with expectedRevision and an idempotency key. Preserve unchanged decided item IDs; reject changed or removed decided objects instead of clearing decisions. |
| `updateStorageReviewDecision` | `PATCH` | `/v1/storage-reviews/{id}/decisions` | `storage-review:read, storage-review:write` | Save one pending item decision using fields.checklistRevision, itemId, decision (keep/trash/defer/null), expectedRevision and an idempotency key. A trash choice is a review decision, never filesystem deletion or permanent-delete authorization. |
| `claimRequirementExecution` | `POST` | `/v1/requirement-events/claims` | `requirements:read, requirements:write` | Claim one current executable owner requirement with a bounded fenced lease; independently GET its requirement execution projection. |
| `updateRequirementExecution` | `PATCH` | `/v1/requirement-events/claims/{id}` | `requirements:read, requirements:write` | Renew an existing lease or write fenced progress through the original requirement writer. Preserve original body/key for unknown outcomes and independently GET the current requirement. |
| `snapshotRequirements` | `GET` | `/v1/requirements/snapshot` | `requirements:read` | Read the complete server-composed public and own private requirement pool, optional owner workflow (state/purpose/nextStep), exact baseline bindings and revisions, or fail without a partial inventory. |
| `getRequirement` | `GET` | `/v1/requirements/{id}` | `requirements:read` | Read one stable public LO-ID or private UUID, full editable fields including optional workflow (state/purpose/nextStep) and its baseline binding. |
| `createRequirement` | `POST` | `/v1/requirements` | `requirements:read, requirements:write` | Create one private requirement with six required fields, optional workflow (state/purpose/nextStep) and an idempotency key; engineering evidence and owner acceptance remain authoritative. |
| `updateRequirement` | `PATCH` | `/v1/requirements/{id}` | `requirements:read, requirements:write` | Update six required fields and optional workflow with expectedRevision, exact baselineBinding and an idempotency key. Omitted workflow is preserved; null clears it. Public first edit uses revision 0; baseline changes conflict. Workflow never changes engineering evidence or owner acceptance. |
| `previewTodoClassification` | `POST` | `/v1/todo-classifications/preview` | `todo:read, organization:read` | Preview one immutable classification of 1 to 100 todos without business writes; owner review is required. |
| `commitTodoClassification` | `POST` | `/v1/todo-classifications/commit` | `todo:read, todo:write, organization:read` | Atomically commit an owner-approved plan with its digest and an idempotency key; preserve the same key and body for unknown-result recovery. |
| `discoverV2` | `GET` | `/v2/capabilities` | `valid grant` | Discover operations permitted for the current grant. |
| `discover` | `GET` | `/v1/capabilities` | `todo:read` | Discover operations permitted for the current grant. |
| `listTodos` | `GET` | `/v1/todos` | `todo:read` | Read a bounded list of todo summaries. |
| `snapshotTodos` | `GET` | `/v1/todos/snapshot` | `todo:read` | Read the complete current todo snapshot with fields and revisions, or fail if complete coverage cannot be verified. |
| `getTodo` | `GET` | `/v1/todos/{id}` | `todo:read` | Read a todo and its current revision. |
| `createTodo` | `POST` | `/v1/todos` | `todo:write` | Create one todo with an idempotency key; optional plannedStartOn/plannedEndOn are explicit ISO dates or null, separate from dueOn. |
| `updateTodo` | `PATCH` | `/v1/todos/{id}` | `todo:write` | Update one todo with its expected revision, original five required fields and an idempotency key; omitted optional plannedStartOn/plannedEndOn preserve saved dates, explicit null clears. |
| `snapshotOrganization` | `GET` | `/v1/organization/snapshot` | `organization:read` | Read the complete current project, domain and topic snapshot with source IDs and revisions, or fail without returning a partial inventory. |
| `getOrganization` | `GET` | `/v1/organization/{type}/{id}` | `organization:read` | Read one project, domain or topic with complete fields and its current revision. |
| `createOrganization` | `POST` | `/v1/organization/{type}` | `organization:read, organization:write` | Create one project, domain or topic with fields and an idempotency key; project personal metadata accepts optional plannedStartOn/plannedEndOn; identical names remain independent records. |
| `updateOrganization` | `PATCH` | `/v1/organization/{type}/{id}` | `organization:read, organization:write` | Update one project, domain or topic with expectedRevision, all four fields (title, text, occurredOn, personal) and an idempotency key; omitted optional project planning dates preserve saved dates, explicit null clears. |
